newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND FORCED TO RESHUFFLE PACK.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND FORCED TO RESHUFFLE PACK.

text.p: Injuries have forced England to call up two uncapped lock forwards for their forthcoming rugby union tour to Argentina.
Sale's Dave Baldwin replaces his clubmate John Fowler, who has damaged knee ligaments, and Coventry's Danny Grewcock replaces Martin Bayfield who has a groin injury.
England depart next Sunday for a tour which includes two tests against Argentina in Buenos Aires.
